name: runway-agent
description: Runway Agent's skills and controller CLI: file shaped work as tickets in the controller's SQLite store with risk set (file-tickets), work a dispatched ticket on a worker inside Herdr and report through typed receipts (work-ticket), review the exact head on the other model (review-ticket). The runway-agent CLI owns every rule: the atomic claim at dispatch, outbox pull with dedupe, and the merge gate. Pairs with pm-sp; works without it.
